item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. New capabilities will unlock new industries, expand demand and create work we cannot yet imagine.

2. We see superintelligent AI as a job creator, not a jobs apocalypse. If it arrives within the next 20 years, it will generate more jobs than it displaces by turning previously impossible ideas into businesses, services and careers.

3. We reject the idea that there is a fixed amount of work to go around. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We want workers equipped to seize those opportunities.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will create more jobs than it eliminates. We see its extraordinary capabilities opening new industries, making ambitious projects affordable and expanding demand for human talent. That transformation will replace some existing roles, but it will also generate new businesses, professions and opportunities on a larger scale. We reject the idea that automating today’s tasks means exhausting tomorrow’s possibilities. Our priority is to prepare people for the work ahead through education, accessible training and support for workers changing careers. We are backing a future with more jobs—and working to make its opportunities widely shared.
